_README: Tables Mimir cannot mine, kept here so every value has a stated origin.
resinCosts: read off the domain and boss entry screens in game. They are
stable but not in ExcelBinOutput (enterCostItems is empty in the
datamine), so they are seeded here and are yours to verify. A wrong
value here skews the whole per-resin ranking, so it is worth a glance.
reactionCoefficients: deliberately absent. They live in the ability
configs under BinOutput rather than in a table, and Mimir refuses to
guess a damage multiplier. Transformative reaction damage stays
unavailable, with an error saying so, until they are mined properly.
dropModel: deliberately absent. Mimir estimates it from your own
inventory instead - see `mimir dropmodel`. That estimate is measured
rather than assumed, and it is labelled with the bias it carries.
